risks.risk: The TV may not be 55 inches or UHD 4K as claimed.
risks.proof: A photo showing the TV from a distance with a known object for scale, or a close-up of the model label on the back or bezel.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic Android TV without confirmed size or resolution.

risks.risk: The TV may have physical damage, dead pixels, or screen issues not visible in the current screen capture.
risks.proof: A photo of the TV from the front showing the entire screen with a solid color (e.g., white or black) to check for dead pixels or blemishes, and a photo of the back or side showing the condition of the frame and ports.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially defective or with hidden screen damage.

risks.risk: The TV may be missing accessories (remote, cables, stand, etc.) despite the seller's claim.
risks.proof: A photo showing all accessories laid out next to the TV.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as missing accessories, which reduces value.

risks.risk: The TV may not be in working condition or may have software issues (e.g., region lock, language settings, or app functionality).
risks.proof: A video clip showing the TV turning on, navigating through menus, and playing a video from an app like YouTube or Netflix.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working or with software issues.

proof_requests: Photo of the TV from the back or side showing the model label and ports.
Photo of the TV screen displaying a solid color (white/black) to check for dead pixels.
Photo of all accessories (remote, cables, stand, etc.) laid out next to the TV.
Video clip showing the TV turning on, navigating menus, and playing a video.
Photo of the TV from a distance with a known object for scale to confirm 55-inch size.
